card.name: Fasting and stopping before a procedure
card.fires_on: Words in pre-procedure instructions about not eating, drinking, exercising or taking medicines, such as eat, drink, stop eating, or prior just before a time period or procedure.

modes.label: Fasting verbs
modes.description: Eat, eating, drink or drinking in an instruction to stop food or fluids before a test.
modes.example: Advise patients not to<< eat>> or drink for at least 4 hours

modes.label: Prior after a time span
modes.description: The word prior right after a length of time, leading into the procedure or test.
modes.example: instruct patient to fast for 4 – 6 hours<< prior>> to the drug’s injection.

modes.label: Medications to hold
modes.description: The word medications or or in a list of things to stop or withhold before a procedure.
modes.example: It may be necessary for you to stop these<< medications>> prior to the procedure.
